mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qc_record(id,kind,project_id,parent_id,body,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{kind},#{projectId},#{parentId},#{body},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kind=VALUES(kind),project_id=VALUES(project_id),parent_id=VALUES(parent_id),body=VALUES(body)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM qc_record WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM qc_record WHERE kind=#{kind} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND parent_id=#{parentId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qc_record WHERE kind=#{kind} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND parent_id=#{parentId}
SELECT * FROM qc_record WHERE kind=#{kind} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND parent_id=#{parentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM qc_record WHERE kind=#{kind} AND parent_id=#{parentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM qc_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM qc_task WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 8
SELECT * FROM qc_task WHERE project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE qc_task SET status='RUNNING',attempt=attempt+1,updated_at=#{now},lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt < 3 AND #{leaseUntil} > #{claimNow}

UPDATE qc_task SET status=#{status},stage=#{stage},progress=#{progress},error=#{error},updated_at=#{updatedAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until >= #{leaseNow}

UPDATE qc_task SET status='PENDING',stage='任务租约过期，等待恢复',progress=0,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{expiredBefore})
UPDATE qc_task SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until >= #{renewNow} AND #{leaseUntil} > #{renewNow}

UPDATE qc_task SET status='PENDING',stage='等待执行资源',attempt=CASE WHEN attempt > 0 THEN attempt-1 ELSE 0 END,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE qc_task SET lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status <> 'RUNNING'
UPDATE qc_task SET status='FAILED',stage='已达到最大尝试次数',error='任务已尝试3次，请检查输入或配置后重新发起',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt >= 3
UPDATE qc_task SET status='PENDING',stage='等待重试',error=NULL,progress=0,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED' AND attempt < 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qc_evidence_operation_lease(operation_key,project_id,owner,lease_until,acquired_at) SELECT #{operationKey},#{projectId},#{owner},#{leaseUntil},#{acquiredAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qc_evidence_operation_lease WHERE operation_key=#{operationKey})

INSERT INTO qc_evidence_operation_lease(operation_key,project_id,owner,lease_until,acquired_at) SELECT #{operationKey},#{projectId},#{owner},#{leaseUntil},#{acquiredAt} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qc_evidence_operation_lease WHERE operation_key=#{operationKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE qc_evidence_operation_lease SET owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},acquired_at=#{now} WHERE operation_key=#{operationKey} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND lease_until <= #{now}
UPDATE qc_evidence_operation_lease SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE operation_key=#{operationKey} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > #{now} AND #{leaseUntil} > #{now}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM qc_evidence_operation_lease WHERE operation_key=#{operationKey} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND owner=#{owner}
